author: Aldrin Payopay
what_happened: The 21st registered run of the measurability pilot was interrupted mid-write in a session that ended before it finished. The runner writes its JSON record only after the last epoch, so the attempt left a mesh and no record - and therefore no page-error list. The pre-registration allows a crashed run to be re-run once, before scoring; it was, and only then was the arm scored.

check.claim: the re-run reproduced the interrupted attempt exactly over its 19 epochs
check.rule: sha256 of the first 19*32768 float32 values of the re-run mesh equals the interrupted file's whole-file sha256

note: The mesh files are excluded from the repository by .gitignore, as every mesh in this programme is. The check above is reproducible by anyone who re-runs the cell from its seed on the same build: hash the first 19 epochs of the result and compare. The pre-registration's "re-run once" is not machine-enforced; it is evidenced here by the retained partial mesh, this receipt and the re-run log beside it (rerun_2026-09-07.txt).
